links.comparator_used: Generating all reports without abstention (no rejection of high-uncertainty reports)
links.outcome: Factuality score of retained radiology reports (Radialog on MIMIC-CXR)
links.effect: Factuality scores improved by 10% when rejecting 20% of reports
links.tradeoff: 20% of reports are rejected/abstained from and would need human handling
links.quote: By abstaining from high-uncertainty reports, our approach improves factuality scores by 10%, achieved by rejecting 20% of reports using the Radialog model on the MIMIC-CXR dataset.

links.outcome: Hallucination detection and factual accuracy of generated radiology reports; flagging lowest-precision sentence
links.effect: Sentence-level uncertainty flags the lowest-precision sentence in each report with an 82.9% success rate; report-level filtering improves factuality by 10% at 20% rejection
links.quote: Furthermore, sentence-level uncertainty flags the lowestprecision sentence in each report with an 82.9% success rate.

design_hint: uncertainty-based abstention and sentence-level flagging of generated reports
